999999999.bio: 999999999 is an Italian techno duo known for their raw, high-energy approach to acid and hard techno. Their performances often feature fast-paced, improvised live sets built around pounding drums and relentless acid lines. With a gritty underground sound and intense club energy, 999999999 have become staples of the global rave and warehouse scene.

adam-ten.bio: Adam Ten is an Israeli DJ and producer known for his dark, hypnotic blend of house and techno infused with raw groove and emotional tension. Rising through the underground via releases on Life And Death and standout global sets, he’s built a reputation for immersive, late-night storytelling on the dance floor. With a sound that’s both minimal and intense, Adam Ten has become a key figure in the new wave of underground electronic music.
adam-ten.name: Adam Ten

afrojack.bio: Afrojack is the stage name of Dutch DJ, producer, and songwriter Nick van de Wall, one of the pioneers of modern EDM. Known for festival anthems, massive mainstage performances, and hit collaborations with artists like David Guetta, Pitbull, Beyoncé, and Martin Garrix, he’s helped shape dance music for more than a decade.
afrojack.name: Afrojack

ahmed-spins.bio: Ahmed Spins is a Moroccan‑born DJ and producer known for blending Afro house, deep house, and organic dance music into uplifting, groove‑laden sets and productions that resonate globally. He gained widespread recognition with his breakout Anchor Point EP on MoBlack Records—amassing over 100 million streams—and has played major festival stages, including Coachella and EDC Las Vegas, while earning support from artists like Black Coffee, Peggy Gou, and Dennis Cruz. Beyond his own artistry, he’s also the founder of Deep House Bible, a platform and event series dedicated to uplifting emerging talent and celebrating diverse dance music cultures.
ahmed-spins.name: Ahmed Spins

airrica.bio: Airrica is a rising DJ known for high-energy sets that blend house, techno, and underground club sounds. Her performances balance deep grooves with driving rhythms, creating a dynamic atmosphere that keeps dance floors moving. With a sharp ear for crowd energy, Airrica delivers immersive sets that feel both fresh and powerful.
airrica.name: Airrica

alex-wann.bio: Alex Wann is a Paris‑based DJ and electronic music producer known for his infectious blend of Afro house, melodic house, and rhythmic groove‑driven dance music that resonates on both underground and mainstream stages. He broke through globally with his standout rework of Kelis’ “Milkshake,” topped Beatport charts, and has released music on major labels like Defected and Positiva, while earning support from top tastemakers in the scene.
alex-wann.name: Alex Wann

aline-umber.bio: Aline Umber is an electronic music live project and DJ duo from Paris, France, powered by the creative partnership of producers Aline Brooklyn and Aman Umber. Their sound blends house, deep grooves, and eclectic rhythms with improvisational live elements, often featuring guest musicians to make each performance unique and culturally immersive. Known for energetic, unpredictable sets and standout releases on labels like A.B. Records, Aline Umber delivers dynamic, multi‑dimensional experiences that resonate on stages from intimate clubs to international festivals.
aline-umber.name: Aline Umber

anotr.bio: ANOTR is a Dutch house duo known for their groove-driven sound that blends deep house, minimal, and funk-infused rhythms. With releases on labels like Solid Grooves and their own imprint No Art, they’ve built a reputation for infectious basslines and tightly crafted club records. Their high-energy sets have made them staples at global festivals and underground dance floors alike.
anotr.name: ANOTR

armand-van-helden.bio: Armand Van Helden is an American DJ, producer, remixer, and songwriter whose eclectic palette spans house, speed‒3garage, disco, funk and hip‒3hop. He rose from early DJ residencies in Boston and remixer gigs at X‒3Mix to international prominence with breakthrough tracks like ‒32cWitch Doktor‒32d and UK chart‒3topppers ‒32cProfessional Widow‒32d (Tori Amos remix) and his own ‒32cYou Don‒32d Know Me.‒32d His live performances deliver dynamic, genre‒3blending sets rich in rhythm, groove and unexpected hooks, fusing classic dancefloor sensibilities with energetic modern flair.
armand-van-helden.name: Armand Van Helden

arodes.bio: Arodes is a dynamic DJ known for blending deep house grooves with infectious dancefloor energy. His sets weave melodic rhythms with unexpected drops, keeping the crowd fully engaged from start to finish. With a keen ear for both classic and cutting-edge tracks, Arodes delivers an unforgettable experience every time he performs.
arodes.name: Arodes

avello.bio: AVELLO (Adam Lawrence) has experienced one of the fastest rises in dance music, exploding from a regional bass artist into an international festival favorite through a string of viral remixes and emotionally driven original productions. His remixes of “No Broke Boys” and “Electric Love” became festival staples, while collaborations with Gryffin, Adventure Club, Łaszewo, and Big Gigantic showcased his ability to blend melodic emotion with high-energy festival production.
avello.name: AVELLO

azzecca.bio: Azzecca is a rising force in melodic techno, known for dark, hypnotic grooves, driving basslines, and emotionally charged synth work. Her sound blends underground techno energy with melodic tension, earning support from major tastemakers and landing her on lineups at top clubs and festivals worldwide. Behind the decks, Azzecca delivers immersive, high-intensity sets built for late-night moments and locked-in dance floors.
azzecca.name: Azzecca

basement-jaxx.bio: Felix Buxton and Simon Ratcliffe started Basement Jaxx as a Brixton club night in 1994, building a sound that ran house through ragga, samba, punk, R&B and whatever else was in reach. Remedy and Rooty made them one of the defining British dance acts of the era — "Red Alert," "Romeo," "Where's Your Head At" — and Kish Kash took the Grammy for Best Electronic/Dance Album in 2004. Two decades on, their sets remain relentlessly maximalist: vocal-driven, carnival-loud, and built for rooms that want to sweat rather than nod.
basement-jaxx.name: Basement Jaxx

beltran.bio: Beltran is a Brazilian DJ and producer recognized for his groove-driven approach to tech house, combining punchy basslines with minimalist precision. Known for club-focused records and high-energy performances, Beltran has quickly become a staple across international dance floors.
beltran.name: Beltran

black-coffee.bio: Black Coffee is a South African DJ and producer known for his deep, soulful approach to house music, blending Afro-house rhythms with jazz, soul, and minimal textures. After losing the use of his left arm in a childhood accident, he rose from Durban to global acclaim, headlining the world’s biggest festivals and earning a Grammy for his album Subconsciously. Renowned for immersive, emotionally rich sets, Black Coffee is a defining force in modern electronic music, bringing African dance culture to the global stage.
black-coffee.name: Black Coffee

blondish.bio: Blond:ish is a genre-blending force in electronic music, known for her uplifting house and techno sound, infectious energy, and deep, soul-forward grooves. A global favorite from Burning Man to Ibiza, she brings feel-good rhythms and conscious vibes to every set, turning dance floors into full-on communal experiences. Expect hypnotic beats, spiritual undertones, and a party that feels as good as it sounds.
blondish.name: Blond:ish

bob-moses.bio: Bob Moses is a Canadian electronic music duo from Vancouver, consisting of Tom Howie and Jimmy Vallance, known for blending deep house, indie, and rock influences into emotive, atmospheric tracks. They gained widespread recognition with hits like Tearing Me Up and their critically acclaimed album Days Gone By, earning a Grammy nomination along the way. Bob Moses is celebrated for their cinematic productions and live performances, which combine DJ sets with live instrumentation to create immersive, danceable experiences.
bob-moses.name: Bob Moses

broken-hill.bio: Broken Hill is a Southern California–based DJ, producer, and audio engineer whose immersive blend of indie dance, house, and techno has rapidly gained global support from tastemakers like Solomun, Adam Ten, and Four Tet. His dancefloor-ready productions and dynamic sets showcase intricate rhythms, lush melodies, and rolling basslines, earning chart success on Beatport and extensive play across clubs and festivals. With a sharp technical edge and relentless creative drive, Broken Hill continues to push electronic music forward.
broken-hill.name: Broken Hill

brunello.bio: Brunello is an emerging electronic music producer and DJ associated with Mellow Circus Records, a label he launched that blends fresh house and electronic sounds with a creative, almost circus-inspired twist. He’s gaining traction in the modern dance music scene with releases like “The Clown’s Corridor,” “Lost in the Mellow Circus,” and “Illusions,” showcasing a groove-centric house and electronic style that’s both inventive and dancefloor-ready.
brunello.name: Brunello

brutalismus-3000.bio: Made up of Theo Zeitner and Victoria Vassiliki Daldas, Brutalismus 3000 formed in Berlin and quickly built a cult following by rejecting the seriousness often associated with the city’s techno scene. Instead, the duo embraces chaos, blending hard techno, gabber, electroclash, punk, hardstyle, and hyperpop into a sound that’s as theatrical as it is aggressive. Their music combines crushing kicks, distorted synths, shouted vocals, and satirical lyrics, creating an experience that’s equal parts rave and punk show.
brutalismus-3000.name: Brutalismus 3000

camelphat.bio: CamelPhat are a Grammy-nominated DJ and production duo known for shaping modern house and melodic techno with emotionally driven, club-ready records. Renowned for their immersive sound and global headline performances, CamelPhat remain a defining force on the world’s biggest dance floors.
camelphat.name: CamelPhat

carlita.bio: Carlita is a DJ and producer known for blending melodic house, indie dance, and organic house with global and classical influences. Her sets combine hypnotic grooves with melodic textures, often incorporating live instrumentation and eclectic sounds. She has become a staple at major clubs and festivals, bringing a sophisticated, cosmopolitan energy to the dancefloor.
carlita.name: Carlita

chloe-caillet.bio: Chloé Caillet is a New York–born DJ and producer known for her vibrant, groove-driven house sets that blend disco, techno, and global influences. She broke out with releases on CircoLoco Records and has since become a fixture at major clubs and festivals worldwide. As the founder of SMIILE, she champions inclusivity and community while delivering high-energy, emotionally charged performances.
chloe-caillet.name: Chloe Caillet

chris-lake-2879b.bio: Chris Lake is a British DJ and producer known for his infectious house and tech-house tracks that dominate dancefloors worldwide. With a knack for blending groovy basslines, catchy hooks, and high-energy drops, he has become a staple in both festival mainstages and underground clubs. His releases and remixes consistently push the boundaries of electronic music, making him a favorite among house music fans everywhere.
chris-lake-2879b.name: Chris Lake

club-de-combat.bio: Clüb De Combat is an Israeli electronic music duo known for blending acid house, disco, and industrial-influenced house into energetic, genre-crossing productions and DJ sets. They’ve released music like On Repeat, Exciter EP, Wai Wai and remixes such as Bad Habit (Clüb De Combat Remix), gaining global support and performances at clubs and events. Their sound is rooted in classic club influences while pushing modern electronic floor energy.
club-de-combat.name: Club De Combat

coco-prosecco.bio:
Based in Brooklyn, Coco Prosecco has quickly become a familiar face in New York’s underground nightlife through her eclectic, groove-driven approach behind the decks. Her sets pull from hardgroove, funk house, nu-disco, techno, Latin rhythms, and classic club records, creating an atmosphere that’s energetic, playful, and impossible to stand still in. Rather than sticking to one lane, she builds momentum by weaving together unexpected sounds while keeping dancers at the center of every set. 

A regular at venues including Mood Ring, Honey’s, Gabriela, and Night Club 101, Coco Prosecco has become known for cultivating inclusive spaces that celebrate community as much as music. Whether she’s playing an intimate rooftop session or an all-night warehouse party, her sets are rooted in groove, warmth, and the belief that the dance floor should be a place for everyone.
coco-prosecco.name: Coco Prosecco

crankdat.bio: Crankdat is an American electronic music producer and DJ known for his high-energy remixes and original tracks that blend elements of dubstep, trap, and bass music. He gained widespread recognition through his creative "Re-Crank" series, where he puts his signature heavy, aggressive spin on popular songs across various genres. His dynamic sound design and intense drops have made him a prominent figure in the festival and bass music scene.
crankdat.name: Crankdat

david-lindmer.bio: David Lindmer is a British producer and DJ based in Brooklyn, and the co-founder of melodic techno label Running Clouds alongside Andrea Vizzarro. His sound leans on raw analog basslines and cinematic, melody-driven leads, with releases on Afterlife, Purified, Atlant and Oddity, and support from Tale Of Us, Mind Against, Kevin de Vries and Nora En Pure. In 2022 he co-founded Chromia Sounds with Massano and Un:said, and his tracks have been played at ADE Awakenings and Afterlife Tulum.
david-lindmer.name: David Lindmer

devault-c7d91.bio: DeVault is a Canadian DJ and producer known for his sleek, cinematic approach to electronic music, blending elements of house, R&B, and pop into a polished and emotionally resonant sound. Based in Toronto, he has built a loyal following through his carefully crafted productions that feel equally at home in intimate listening sessions as they do on a dancefloor. His sophisticated aesthetic and melodic sensibility have positioned him as a distinctive voice in the modern electronic music landscape.
devault-c7d91.name: Devault

diplo-9f172.bio: Diplo is the Mississippi-born, LA-based producer Thomas Wesley Pentz, who took his stage name from Diplodocus thanks to a childhood obsession with dinosaurs and was working as a Philadelphia public school teacher when he co-produced M.I.A.'s "Paper Planes." The Mad Decent label he founded in 2006 turned into a launchpad for moombahton, trap and Latin-leaning dance music, while side projects keep multiplying: Major Lazer with the global smash "Lean On," Jack Ü with Skrillex, LSD with Sia and Labrinth, Silk City with Mark Ronson, and a full country detour released under his given name. From schoolteacher to multi-Grammy mainstay, his real instrument is taste, and his catalog reads less like a discography and more like a map of where popular music has been heading for the past fifteen years.
diplo-9f172.name: Diplo

dixon.bio: Dixon is a tastemaker and sonic architect—crafting deep, atmospheric journeys that blur the line between house, techno, and the unexpected. Known for his meticulous mixing and emotional restraint, his sets unfold slowly, pulling dancers into a hypnotic, immersive flow. Whether behind the decks or shaping the culture through Innervisions, Dixon delivers music that’s subtle, sophisticated, and deeply felt on the floor.
dixon.name: Dixon

dom-dolla.bio: Dom Dolla is an Australian house and tech-house producer known for punchy basslines, crisp percussion, and infectious vocal hooks. He broke through globally with hits like “Take It” and “San Frandisco,” earning ARIA Awards and a Grammy nomination while becoming a staple on festival and Ibiza lineups. Blending underground groove with mainstage energy, Dom Dolla has emerged as one of the leading figures in modern tech house.
dom-dolla.name: Dom Dolla

dreya-v.bio: Dreya V is an emerging DJ and electronic music artist known for her vibrant, genre-blending sets that fuse house, techno, and melodic elements. She has been building a strong presence through live performances and a growing catalog of releases. With a distinctive sound and energetic style, she continues to gain attention across the underground dance scene.
dreya-v.name: DREYA V

dylan-brady.bio:
Raised in St. Louis, Missouri, Dylan Brady began releasing experimental music on SoundCloud while studying audio engineering before breaking through with his 2019 project 100 gecs alongside Laura Les. Their debut album and follow-up 1000 gecs helped define the hyperpop movement, inspiring a new generation of artists with their maximalist production, distorted vocals, and genre-defying approach. Outside of 100 gecs, Brady has collaborated with Skrillex, Charli XCX, Dorian Electra, Rico Nasty, JPEGMAFIA, and Porter Robinson, while producing for artists across pop, hip-hop, and electronic music. 

As a solo artist and DJ, Brady’s sets are just as unpredictable as his productions, bouncing between hyperpop, dubstep, Jersey club, trance, techno, rap edits, and unreleased originals. Whether he’s performing at Coachella, Boiler Room-style events, or underground clubs, his performances thrive on chaos, humor, and constant surprises, making every set feel completely unique.
dylan-brady.name: Dylan Brady

emanuel-satie-b4619.bio: Emanuel Satie is a German DJ and producer who has become a respected name in the deeper, more melodic corners of the electronic music world, known for his refined and soulful approach to house music. He has released music on some of the scene's most esteemed labels and is equally celebrated for his warm, sophisticated DJ sets that reflect a deep love and knowledge of dance music history. His artistic name pays homage to the French composer Erik Satie, hinting at the musicality and emotional depth that defines his work.
emanuel-satie-b4619.name: Emanuel Satie

enamour.bio: Enamour has carved out a distinctive place in melodic electronic music by creating records that balance emotion with dance-floor energy. Refusing to be confined to one style, his sound blends progressive house, melodic techno, deep house, and psychedelic influences into cinematic productions that feel equally at home in a club or on headphones.
enamour.name: Enamour

federico-barga.bio: Originally from Buenos Aires, Federico Barga discovered electronic music at a young age and began producing while also pursuing an acting career. After relocating to Miami, he immersed himself in the city’s progressive and melodic house scene, earning support from respected artists including Hernán Cattáneo, Guy Mantzur, Khen, Martin Garcia, Marcelo Vasami, and Nicolás Rada. His releases on labels such as Mango Alley, Purrfection, Kitchen Recordings, and Venture Records have consistently landed in Beatport’s Progressive House charts.
federico-barga.name: Federico Barga

fisher.bio: FISHER is a high-energy house music powerhouse known for bass-driven grooves and infectious crowd-first sets. Blending club chaos with undeniable charisma, he turns every stage into a full-on party.
fisher.name: Fisher

four-tet.bio: Four Tet brings a loose, hypnotic energy that floats between dusty jazz loops, ambient textures, and heavy warehouse grooves. He is famous for pulling micro-samples out of nowhere, turning random YouTube clips or old folk records into peak-time club anthems. His sets feel completely unpredictable but totally locked in, moving easily from quiet, beautiful moments straight into driving garage rhythms. It is raw, experimental electronic music that never takes itself too seriously.
four-tet.name: Four Tet

francis-mercier.bio: Francis Mercier is a Haitian DJ and producer recognized as one of the leading global voices in Afro-house. Known for weaving African and Caribbean rhythms into modern electronic music, Mercier has built an international following through high-energy performances, culturally rich productions, and a sound that bridges continents.
francis-mercier.name: Francis Mercier

franky-rizardo.bio: Franky Rizardo is a Dutch DJ and producer known for his groovy, melodic take on house and tech house, blending warm basslines with emotional, dancefloor-ready energy. Rising from the European club circuit, he has become a staple at major festivals and Ibiza residencies while releasing on top labels. Renowned for smooth yet powerful sets, Franky Rizardo bridges underground credibility with feel-good, peak-time house.
franky-rizardo.name: Franky Rizardo

funk-tribu-fc448.bio: Funk Tribu is a DJ and producer known for his fast, rave-inspired blend of techno, trance, and hard groove. His sound combines nostalgic 90s rave elements with modern club energy, featuring euphoric synths, driving kicks, and high-BPM momentum. Funk Tribu has gained strong support across the underground electronic scene and international festival circuit.
funk-tribu-fc448.name: Funk Tribu

gabss.bio: Gabss is a DJ and producer known for delivering high-energy sets rooted in house and tech house. His sound blends driving basslines, infectious grooves, and crowd-focused selections designed to keep the dance floor moving. With a growing reputation in the underground circuit, Gabss continues to build momentum through club performances and fresh releases.
gabss.name: Gabss

genesi.bio: Genesi is an electronic DJ and producer known for hypnotic, groove-driven records that balance depth with dance-floor power. Blending refined rhythms with a modern club sensibility, Genesi crafts music designed to move crowds while maintaining a sleek, forward-thinking edge.
genesi.name: Genesi

green-velvet.bio: Green Velvet is a Chicago house legend and true original — a genre-shaping producer, DJ, and the mind behind the iconic Cajmere alias. Known for his unmistakable voice, hypnotic grooves, and tracks that blend raw house, techno, and funk, he’s been a driving force in underground dance music for decades. From anthems like “Flash” and “Percolator” to his high-energy, no-nonsense DJ sets, Green Velvet brings a perfect mix of grit, soul, and attitude to every dancefloor. A pioneer who still sounds futuristic, his shows are pure, unfiltered club culture.
green-velvet.name: Green Velvet

griz.bio: GRiZ has built a career around breaking genre boundaries. His music combines funk, soul, hip-hop, dubstep, house, and future bass, all tied together by his unmistakable live saxophone performances. Since releasing his debut album End of the World Party in 2011, he’s become a festival favorite with projects like Good Will Prevail, Ride Waves, and the viral collaboration “Griztronics” with Subtronics. Beyond the music, GRiZ is known for promoting self-expression, inclusivity, and giving back through charitable initiatives, creating a community centered around positivity and connection.
griz.name: GRiZ

gryffin-a1d3e.bio: Gryffin is an electronic music producer and DJ known for blending melodic house with live instrumentation and emotional vocals. His sets combine energetic dance beats with uplifting melodies, creating a festival-ready sound that connects deeply with audiences. Gryffin has become a staple in the global dance music scene with chart-topping tracks and performances at major festivals around the world.
gryffin-a1d3e.name: Gryffin

hills.bio: Hills is an emerging DJ known for crafting immersive, groove-forward sets that blend deep rhythms with high-energy moments. With a sound rooted in underground house and evolving electronic influences, Hills brings a refined yet dynamic style to every performance. Seamlessly moving between melodic elements and driving basslines, their sets create an atmosphere that builds tension, releases energy, and keeps crowds locked in from start to finish. As a rising name in the scene, Hills continues to develop a distinct sonic identity shaped by both global dance trends and underground culture.
hills.name: HILLS

honeyluv.bio:
HoneyLuv took an unconventional path to electronic music, serving in the U.S. Navy before teaching herself to DJ during the pandemic. Within just a few years, she went from livestreaming bedroom sets to performing at Coachella, Tomorrowland, EDC, Brooklyn Mirage, Hï Ibiza, and Defected events around the world. Her breakout records “Your Tongue” and “Thr33 6ix 5ive” established her as one of house music’s most exciting new producers, earning support from BBC Radio 1, DJ Mag, and Beatport.

Today, HoneyLuv is known for blending classic Chicago house influences with modern tech house and soulful club grooves.
honeyluv.name: HoneyLuv

horsegiirl.bio:
Since emerging in 2022, horsegiirL has built an entire fictional universe around her alter ego, Stella Stallion, blending humor with genuinely high-energy dance music. Viral hits like My Barn My Rules and Obsessed introduced millions of fans to her unique mix of Eurodance, hard house, and happy hardcore, while performances at festivals including Tomorrowland, Movement Detroit, III Points, and Lollapalooza have cemented her as one of electronic music’s fastest-rising stars.  

Her sets are equal parts rave and performance art, bouncing between hard dance, pop edits, trance, and tongue-in-cheek storytelling. Beneath the humor is a technically skilled DJ whose infectious energy has made her a favorite among a new generation of clubbers.
horsegiirl.name: horsegiirL

innellea.bio:
Influenced by melodic trends in electronic music he combined the roots of Techno in a very creative way, and came up with his unique and abstract sound.

He took the scene by storm and, having been amongst Groove Magazine’s best newcomers in 2017, left a dusty cloud in his wake. Shortly after, his tracks - with a focus on detailed rhythms - were being heard on the world’s finest stages, proving to be a secret weapon for many.

As a result, productions on the Afterlife label like „Viglians“ or „The World Returns“ attracted artists. After massive releases, Innervisions being just one of them, fans around the world began to follow suit. Live sets with unreleased tracks created a global hype and underlined the diversity of Innellea’s sound.

Whenever in need of driving spheres, impulsive
innellea.name: Innellea

j-worra.bio: J. Worra is an American DJ and producer known for her energetic house sound and commanding presence in the global dance music scene. Blending tech house grooves with bass-driven elements, she has released music on major labels and performed at top festivals and clubs worldwide.
j-worra.name: J. Worra

jackie-hollander-a4ed7.bio: Jackie Hollander is a rising San Francisco-born, Los Angeles-based DJ and electronic music producer known for her dynamic blend of melodic house and techno and euphoric, dancefloor-ready productions. She has released music on respected labels like Nervous Records and IN/ROTATION, and her energetic sets and original tracks have helped establish her as a notable presence in the global electronic scene.
jackie-hollander-a4ed7.name: Jackie Hollander

jamback.bio: Jamback is a Dutch DJ and producer from Moordrecht, Netherlands, known for his groove‑driven minimal tech house and deep house sound that blends emotion with hypnotic dancefloor energy. He’s gained momentum with chart‑topping releases and support from major names in the global house scene, and in 2025 he made his debut on the iconic CircoLoco Records with the emotionally charged single “Positive.” With performances across Europe, Asia, and beyond, Jamback continues to rise as a standout talent in modern underground house music.
jamback.name: Jamback

jamie-jones.bio: Jamie Jones is a Welsh DJ and producer known for his smooth, groove-driven take on house and techno. A co-founder of the Hot Creations label and a central figure in Ibiza’s underground scene, he blends warm basslines, hypnotic rhythms, and subtle funk into long, immersive sets. His sound is refined yet playful, earning him a reputation as one of modern house music’s most influential tastemakers.
jamie-jones.name: Jamie Jones

jigitz.bio: Jigitz is a rising DJ and producer known for groove-driven, bass-forward sets rooted in modern club culture. Blending clean percussion with high-energy rhythms, Jigitz delivers tight, dancefloor-focused performances built for late nights and packed rooms. With a sharp underground sensibility, he continues to build momentum through dynamic sets and forward-moving releases.
jigitz.name: jigitz

jimi-jules.bio: Jimi Jules is a Zurich-born DJ and producer known for his genre-blurring take on house and techno, weaving in jazz, hip-hop, and experimental influences. He's closely tied to the Innervisions family, with his 2021 album +8 and the massive Keinemusik collab "My City's On Fire" (with &ME and Rampa) cementing him as one of the scene's most distinctive voices. His live sets are unpredictable and deeply musical, making him a favorite at clubs and festivals from Panorama Bar to Coachella.
jimi-jules.name: Jimi Jules

johannes-schuster.bio: Johannes Schuster is a techno DJ and producer known for his deep, driving, and hypnotic sound. His sets combine precise mixing, pulsating rhythms, and atmospheric textures to create an immersive journey on the dance floor. With a reputation for delivering high-energy performances, Johannes Schuster captivates audiences with his masterful command of techno. In 2021 Johannes joined the family at Unreal, one of Germany’s premier hard techno outfits, held at infamous Cologne club Bootshaus. Johannes has since become a highly-regarded hard techno artist, travelling the global circuit and igniting dance floors everywhere he plays.
johannes-schuster.name: Johannes Schuster

john-digweed.bio: John Digweed began DJing in his hometown of Hastings, England, before his career changed in 1993 when a demo tape landed in the hands of Sasha. Together, the pair became one of the most influential duos in dance music history, helping define progressive house through landmark mix compilations like Renaissance: The Mix Collection and Northern Exposure. Their legendary residencies at Twilo in New York transformed the art of long-form DJing and inspired generations of selectors.
john-digweed.name: John Digweed

john-summit.bio: John Summit is a chicago-born house music powerhouse known for his high-energy sets, infectious grooves, and crowd-losing moments. Blending tech house with punchy basslines and cheeky vocals, he’s gone from underground favorite to global headliner in record time. Whether it’s a sweaty club or a massive festival stage, John Summit brings pure chaos in the best way.
john-summit.name: John Summit

jordan-brando.bio: Jordan Brando is a Melbourne-born DJ and producer at the forefront of Australia's minimal house movement, known for a groove-heavy sound that moves between house, minimal, and tech. His productions have landed on labels like Shall Not Fade, No Art, Life & Death, and Club Sweat, earning support from heavyweights including Chris Stussy, Prunk, and Dimmish. Alongside his solo work, he co-runs the Not Without Friends label and party collective with Luke Alessi and William Kiss, cementing his role as a driving force in community-led club culture.
jordan-brando.name: Jordan Brando

joris-voorn.bio: Joris Voorn is a Dutch DJ and producer known for blending melodic techno and deep house with emotional, atmospheric soundscapes. Based in Amsterdam, he has released influential records on labels like Green and Rejected, helping shape the modern melodic techno scene. His sets balance driving club energy with melodic depth, making him a regular at major festivals and underground venues worldwide.
joris-voorn.name: Joris Voorn

joseph-capriati.bio: Joseph Capriati is an Italian techno DJ and producer known for his powerful, high-energy sets and deep roots in the global underground scene. Rising from Italy’s club circuit to headline major festivals and venues worldwide, he has released music on influential labels like Drumcode and created the acclaimed Metamorfosi project. With marathon DJ sets and a sound that blends driving techno with melodic and house elements, Capriati remains one of the most respected artists in modern electronic music. 🎧
joseph-capriati.name: Joseph Capriati

joshwa.bio: Joshwa is a UK-based tech house powerhouse known for chunky basslines, crisp percussion, and high-energy grooves built for peak-time dancefloors. With releases on labels like HUGEL’s Make The Girls Dance and Heldeep, his sound blends underground grit with big-room bounce. Whether in the club or on festival stages, Joshwa delivers infectious, no-nonsense house that keeps the crowd locked in.
joshwa.name: Joshwa

joss-dean.bio: Joss Dean is a London-based DJ and producer rising fast through the UK underground house circuit, following in the footsteps of his older brother Max Dean and cousin Luke Dean. He's already sold out headline shows at Joshua Brooks, played Studio 338, and debuted on neXup recs with music road-tested at clubs like DC-10, Amnesia, Drumsheds, and The Warehouse Project. Known for deep, stripped-back grooves and minimal-leaning house, Dean is building momentum around early releases like "Was I Loved?" as one of the scene's most promising young selectors.
joss-dean.name: Joss Dean

jungle.bio: Jungle is a London-based electronic soul collective led by Josh Lloyd-Watson and Tom McFarland. Known for their smooth fusion of funk, soul, and electronic music, Jungle has built a global following through groove-heavy productions and visually distinctive performances, including DJ sets that translate their live sound into a dancefloor-focused experience.
jungle.name: Jungle

kettama.bio: Kettama is an American DJ and producer known for his hard-hitting bass music that blends elements of dubstep, riddim, and trap. With a high-energy approach and aggressive sound design, he’s made a name for himself in the bass and festival electronic scene. Kettama’s tracks and live sets are characterized by heavy drops, distorted low-end, and crowd-crushing intensity that resonates with fans of heavier electronic genres.
kettama.name: Kettama

killen.bio:
Before launching his solo project, Hannes Torssell built an impressive résumé behind the scenes, producing for artists including Swedish House Mafia and RL Grime while remixing songs for acclaimed Scandinavian artists. In 2024, he stepped into the spotlight as Killen., introducing a deeply personal sound built around emotional songwriting, driving electronic production, and melodic hooks. His debut EP, Highlight, earned widespread praise, BBC Radio 1 support, millions of streams, and multiple Spotify editorial placements. 

Since then, Killen. has continued his rapid ascent with releases like ONANON, Mojo, Naive, and High Like The Sky, earning a Swedish Grammy for Best Electronic Act and performing at festivals including Way Out West while expanding into North America. His music sits somewhere between ODESZA, Fred again.., and Barry Can’t Swim—melodic, uplifting, and emotionally resonant without losing its dance-floor energy.
killen.name: Killen.

konstantin.bio: Konstantin is a German DJ and producer from Weimar who co-founded Giegling, one of underground electronic music's most influential and enigmatic labels. His DJ sets blend deep house, techno, and experimental sounds, reflecting the label's signature aesthetic, and he's built a reputation as a key architect of the Giegling sound alongside collaborators like Kettenkarussell. He's a regular on the CircoLoco circuit, having played sets for the brand at Ibiza's DC-10 and international editions including Tulum.
konstantin.name: Konstantin

korolova-0535e.bio: Korolova is a Ukrainian DJ and producer from Kyiv who works primarily in melodic techno and progressive house. She's released on Ultra, Armada, AFTR:HRS, and Get Physical before launching her own label, Captive Soul, in 2023, and has played main-stage Tomorrowland, EDC Las Vegas, and Untold, plus residencies and appearances at Space Miami, Green Valley Brazil, and Hi Ibiza. She cracked DJ Mag's Top 60 in 2024 and sold out a Captive Soul showcase at KOKO in London, with a livestream-heavy online presence that's pulled 170M+ YouTube views.
korolova-0535e.name: Korolova

krol.bio: Krol is a Paris-based electronic music producer and DJ known for a sound that's helped define the newer generation shaping modern house and techno. He's become a regular presence on the CircoLoco circuit, appearing on lineups at DC-10 in Ibiza alongside artists like &ME, Rampa, Honey Dijon, and Chloé Caillet, as well as CircoLoco's New York edition. Krol's rise reflects the label's continued push to platform emerging talent alongside established headliners within its signature house and techno-driven programming.
krol.name: Krol

kuko.bio: Kuko is a forward-thinking electronic artist known for sleek, high-energy sets that blend underground house and techno with a modern edge. Drawing influence from late-night warehouse culture and festival-ready grooves, Kuko delivers driving rhythms, sharp builds, and crowd-locking drops. Whether in an intimate club or on a big stage, Kuko’s sound is designed to keep the dancefloor moving from start to finish.
kuko.name: KUKO

lane-8.bio: Lane 8 is an American DJ, producer, and the founder of the This Never Happened label. Known for his emotional and melodic style, his music blends progressive house and melodic techno with atmospheric textures and storytelling builds. His “no phones on the dance floor” events have become a signature part of his immersive live shows.
lane-8.name: Lane 8

lee-burridge.bio: Lee Burridge is a pioneering British DJ and producer known for his deep, emotive approach to house and electronic music. A key figure behind the global All Day I Dream movement, he’s built a reputation for crafting immersive, melodic sets that blend organic textures with hypnotic rhythms.
lee-burridge.name: Lee Burridge

lee-foss.bio:
Originally from Chicago, Lee Foss discovered house music through the city’s legendary club scene before moving to Europe, where a chance meeting with Jamie Jones in Ibiza led to the creation of Hot Creations in 2008. Together, they helped spark the global tech house revival, introducing artists like Patrick Topping, Richy Ahmed, Solardo, and wAFF while establishing one of dance music’s most respected labels. He’s also one-half of Hot Natured, whose crossover success brought underground house to a much wider audience.

Beyond Hot Creations, Foss launched Repopulate Mars, a label that champions groove-driven house and tech house while nurturing the next generation of producers. As a DJ, he’s known for effortlessly mixing soulful house, disco, Chicago grooves, and modern tech house into marathon sets that have become staples at DC-10 Ibiza, Club Space Miami, Coachella, and festivals around the world.
lee-foss.name: Lee Foss

levity.bio: Levity is a Chicago-based trio — PJ Carberry, John Hauldren, and Josh Tarum — known for a high-energy, genre-bending blend of dubstep, trap, and future bass. After breaking out with "Flip It" and a viral fill-in set at Electric Forest 2024, they signed to Zeds Dead's Deadbeats label and have since racked up over 100 million streams. Their 2026 Coachella debut, complete with a new "Volcano" stage production and a surprise Big Sean appearance, cemented them as one of the fastest-rising live acts in bass music.
levity.name: Levity

lip-critic.bio:
The band’s lineup centers around two drummers, samplers, synths, and vocalist Bret Kaser, creating an intense wall of sound that has earned comparisons to Death Grips while remaining unmistakably their own. 

After self-releasing early projects, Lip Critic signed with Partisan Records and broke through with their acclaimed debut label release, Hex Dealer. Their follow-up, Theft World, further cemented their reputation as one of New York’s most inventive underground bands, blending satire, internet culture, and blistering electronic production into music that’s equally at home in a punk venue or a club.
lip-critic.name: Lip Critic

loukeman.bio: Loukeman is a Toronto‑based producer, multi‑instrumentalist, and DJ whose music fuses lo‑fi dance beats with pitch‑shifted vocals, blending house, R&B, and indie folk. He began releasing under the Loukeman name in the 2010s and gained wide recognition with his Stardog trilogy—Sd‑1 (2021), Sd‑2 (2024), and the forthcoming Sd‑3 (2026), notable for its lush, enigmatic sound and high‑profile collaborations. His live sets translate his intricate studio textures into immersive, emotionally resonant experiences.
loukeman.name: Loukeman

lovefoxy.bio:
Raised in Berlin and immersed in the city’s legendary nightlife from an early age, LOVEFOXY developed a deep appreciation for the uplifting sounds of ‘90s house. In just a few years behind the decks, she’s gone from local clubs to international stages, making standout appearances at Boiler Room, Berghain, DGTL Festival, KOKO London, ADE, and festivals around the world. Her performances are as much about energy as they are music. In fact, she’s known for dancing throughout her sets and creating an infectious atmosphere that pulls everyone into the party. 

Rather than chasing trends, LOVEFOXY celebrates house music’s roots while giving it a fresh, modern edge. Drawing influence from disco, classic Chicago house, and Berlin’s underground, her sets are packed with warm grooves, soulful vocals, and euphoric moments that make it impossible to stand still.
lovefoxy.name: LOVEFOXY

lovra.bio: LOVRA is a Berlin-based DJ and producer known for her vibrant, groove-led house sound that blends catchy vocals with playful, feel-good energy. She’s built a strong global following through releases on labels like Toolroom and appearances at major festivals, standing out for her colorful brand and infectious dancefloor style.
lovra.name: LOVRA

lp-giobbi-fd391.bio: LP Giobbi is an American DJ, producer, and classically trained pianist known for blending house music with live piano and uplifting, disco-infused grooves. As the founder of the Femme House collective, she’s also a strong advocate for gender equity in dance music. Her sets combine high-energy house rhythms with vibrant melodies, creating euphoric, feel-good dance-floor moments at festivals and clubs worldwide.
lp-giobbi-fd391.name: LP Giobbi

lp-rhythm.bio: L.P. Rhythm is a house and tech house DJ/producer known for high-energy sets built around groovy basslines, rolling percussion, and catchy vocal samples. His productions blend underground club sounds with festival-ready momentum, making them staples in dancefloor-focused sets. L.P. Rhythm has been gaining attention in the global house scene with releases that emphasize rhythm-driven grooves and infectious energy.
lp-rhythm.name: L.P. Rhythm

luciano.bio: Luciano is a Swiss-Chilean DJ and producer known for his deep, hypnotic take on house and minimal techno. A key figure in the global underground scene, he rose to prominence through his label Cadenza Records and his long-running residencies at DC-10’s legendary Circoloco parties. His sets blend Latin rhythms with rolling minimal grooves, creating immersive, marathon dance floor journeys.
luciano.name: Luciano

luke-alessi.bio: Luke Alessi is a Melbourne-born DJ and producer who has become one of the fastest-rising names in electronic music, blending house, disco, and electro into groove-led records and high-energy sets. His breakout single "The One" with Chloé Caillet featuring Jocelyn Brown hit #1 on Beatport and earned support from artists like Jamie xx, Peggy Gou, and Chris Stussy, following standout releases including the After Five EP on Life and Death and an EP on Peggy Gou's Gudu Records. Fresh off festival debuts at Portola, CRSSD, and Beyond The Valley, plus a US summer tour and Ibiza residencies, he also runs his own label Coffee Cola and the Not Without Friends collective.
luke-alessi.name: Luke Alessi

lyny.bio: LYNY is a rising U.S.-based electronic artist known for his genre-blurring sound that blends trap, bass, and experimental electronic elements. Gaining traction through viral remixes and distinctive production style, he’s quickly built a strong following in the underground bass scene with high-energy, forward-thinking sets.
lyny.name: LYNY

madeon.bio: Madeon rose to international fame at just 17 years old after his viral “Pop Culture” mashup showcased his extraordinary talent for live performance. Since then, he has released acclaimed albums including Adventure and Good Faith, earning praise for seamlessly combining electronic music with live vocals, cinematic visuals, and emotionally rich songwriting. His groundbreaking Good Faith Live tour redefined what a solo electronic performance could be, while collaborations with artists like Porter Robinson, Lady Gaga, and Coldplay have cemented his reputation as one of dance music’s most respected creatives.
madeon.name: Madeon

mapache-dff40.bio: Map.ache is a German DJ and producer whose sound sits in melodic, hypnotic house territory, closely associated with the Giegling collective and its underground sensibility. His music has been featured on labels like Permanent Vacation, /about blank, and his own KANN label, and he has released on CircoLoco Records, the label born from CircoLoco's partnership with Rockstar Games. He's built a strong reputation as a master of melodic house over more than a decade, and is a regular fixture on CircoLoco's Ibiza and worldwide lineups.
mapache-dff40.name: Map.ache

marco-carola.bio: Marco Carola is a pioneering force in modern techno — a master of precision, groove, and endurance behind the decks. Known for marathon DJ sets and razor-sharp mixing, the Naples-born icon helped shape the sound of minimal and tech-house through his influential Music On brand. His style is hypnotic and driving, built on rolling basslines, crisp percussion, and subtle tension that keeps dancefloors locked in for hours. From Ibiza superclubs to underground warehouses, Marco Carola delivers a focused, high-energy experience that’s all about the music, the crowd, and the long journey in between.
marco-carola.name: Marco Carola

marsolo.bio: Marsolo is a DJ and producer known for blending melodic house and techno with atmospheric, emotional soundscapes. His sets balance deep grooves with cinematic builds, creating immersive dance floor moments that feel both powerful and introspective. Marsolo has been gaining attention for his polished productions and dynamic live performances across the underground electronic scene.
marsolo.name: Marsolo

mason-collective.bio: Mason collective is a london-born house and techno trio known for their high-energy, groove-driven sound. blending rolling basslines, punchy percussion, and sharp vocals, they’ve carved out a signature style built for packed dance floors. With releases on labels like solid grooves, hot creations, and elrow, mason collective has become a staple of modern club culture and a favorite across major festivals and underground rooms alike.
mason-collective.name: Mason Collective

massano-c9b39.bio:
Massano, a leading figure in the Melodic Techno scene, rose to prominence with his hit "The Feeling" and his debut Afterlife EP "In My System." This EP swiftly climbed the Beatport charts, showcasing his wide appeal by earning support from top DJs like Tale of Us, Calvin Harris, and David Guetta. Recognized for his dynamic DJ sets, Massano has performed at major events like the FIFA World Cup and Tomorrowland. 

In 2023, he was ranked the #3 best-selling Melodic Techno artist over the past year, bolstered by releases on Afterlife and Drumcode Records, as well as notable remixes for Depeche Mode. Massano launched his own label, Simulate, blending music and futuristic themes, aiming to nurture emerging talent while expanding his influence in electronic music. With a prolific schedule of rele
massano-c9b39.name: Massano

mau-p.bio: Mau P is a Dutch DJ and producer who has rapidly risen as one of the most exciting forces in modern tech house. Known for groove-driven productions and high-impact club records, Mau P has captured global attention through chart-topping releases and electrifying performances across the world’s biggest dance floors.
mau-p.name: Mau P

max-styler.bio: Max Styler is a driving force in modern tech house, known for punchy basslines, sharp percussion, and club-ready energy that hits every time. Blending underground grit with crossover appeal, his releases on labels like Diynamic, Solotoko, and Toolroom have made him a staple in dance floors and festivals worldwide. Whether in the studio or behind the decks, Max Styler delivers high-impact sets built for peak-time moments and nonstop movement.
max-styler.name: Max Styler

me-2d1be.bio: Âme is the German duo of Kristian Beyer and Frank Wiedemann, who met in a Karlsruhe record shop over a shared love of Chicago house and Detroit techno and went on to co-found Innervisions alongside Dixon. Their 2005 track Rej remains one of the defining records of modern deep house, and they've continued releasing on Innervisions ever since, most recently the RY X collaboration Love Is The Dance earlier this year. The two split duties — Kristian plays long-form DJ sets while Frank performs live — and they occasionally combine both formats as Âme II Âme.
me-2d1be.name: Âme

me-9040a.bio: &ME is a Berlin-based DJ and producer widely regarded as one of the most innovative figures in contemporary house and techno. A founding member of the Keinemusik collective — alongside Adam Port, Rampa, and Reznik — he helped build the label into a globally recognized force in electronic music since its inception in 2009. Known for an extensive catalog of solo releases, remixes, and collaborations, he has consistently delivered dancefloor material that earns placement in sets from the world's most respected DJs.
me-9040a.name: &ME

meduza-b25e8.bio: Meduza is an Italian house music trio known for sleek, melodic productions that blend deep house grooves with radio-ready vocals. They broke onto the global dance scene with their massive 2019 hit “Piece of Your Heart,” which earned a Grammy nomination and dominated club charts worldwide. Meduza’s sound sits at the intersection of underground house and mainstream electronic music, making them a staple at major festivals and clubs.
meduza-b25e8.name: Meduza

mestiza.bio: MËSTIZA is a Spanish female DJ and producer duo known for blending electronic music with traditional Spanish influences, especially flamenco-inspired sounds. Their sets fuse modern club energy with cultural elements, creating a distinctive, high-energy style that’s gained attention across Europe’s house and melodic techno scenes.
mestiza.name: Mestiza

mochakk.bio: Mochakk is a Brazilian DJ and producer known for his high-energy, groove-driven house sound that blends classic influences with a modern edge. He’s built a global following through infectious basslines, playful rhythms, and an unmistakable stage presence. His sets are feel-good, dancefloor-focused, and designed to keep crowds moving from start to finish.
mochakk.name: Mochakk

mph.bio: MPH is a UK-based DJ and producer known for energetic sets rooted in UK garage, bass house, and speed garage. His music blends punchy basslines, chopped vocals, and fast-paced rhythms that bring a nostalgic UK club sound into modern dance floors. MPH has built a strong following through viral releases and high-energy performances across the underground and festival circuit.
mph.name: MPH

nic-fanciulli.bio: Nic Fanciulli is a renowned British DJ and producer, celebrated for his masterful blend of house and techno. With a career spanning over two decades, he’s known for delivering deeply melodic yet driving sets that balance underground credibility with broad dancefloor appeal. Fanciulli’s productions are polished and emotive, often weaving hypnotic grooves with dynamic rhythms, making him a favorite at top clubs and festivals worldwide. His performances are immersive journeys that keep crowds moving while showcasing his signature sonic sophistication.
nic-fanciulli.name: Nic Fanciulli

nimino.bio: Nimino is a UK-based producer known for his atmospheric, sample-driven sound that blends electronic music with elements of downtempo and UK garage. His music is characterized by warm textures, nostalgic vocal chops, and layered, emotive production that creates a deeply immersive listening experience. Gaining widespread attention through viral releases and streaming platforms, Nimino has carved out a unique space between chill electronic and dancefloor-ready grooves. His sets balance laid-back, introspective moments with subtle rhythmic energy, offering a refreshing and distinctive take on modern electronic music.
nimino.name: nimino

noizu.bio: Noizu is a British DJ, producer, and rising name in the house and bass house scene known for hard-hitting drops, catchy hooks, and energetic dancefloor-ready tracks. Blending elements of house, electro, and bass music, Noizu has gained international attention with releases on major labels and support from top DJs, making waves in clubs and festivals worldwide.
noizu.name: Noizu

notre-dame.bio: Notre Dame is a Paris-based DJ and producer known for his emotive, melodic house sound that blends nostalgic synths with modern club energy. His productions and DJ sets are recognized for their cinematic atmosphere and uplifting grooves, earning support across the global house and melodic techno scene.
notre-dame.name: Notre Dame

olive-f.bio: Olive F is a DJ and producer known for her high-energy sets and growing presence in the underground club scene. She has been building recognition through club performances and curated lineups, showcasing a confident and engaging approach to DJing. With a strong focus on rhythm and crowd connection, she continues to establish herself as an emerging artist.
olive-f.name: Olive F

omar-d413f.bio: Omar+ is an electronic artist known for blending hypnotic grooves with high-energy club rhythms. His sound sits at the intersection of underground house and techno, built for late-night dance floors and immersive sets. With a sharp ear for tension and release, Omar+ delivers driving, crowd-focused performances.
omar-d413f.name: Omar+

omri.bio: OMRI is a DJ and producer known for emotive, melodic house and techno that blends deep grooves with atmospheric, cinematic elements. His sound is driven by rich melodies and steady rhythms, creating immersive sets that move seamlessly between introspective and dancefloor-ready moments. With releases and performances gaining traction in the underground scene, OMRI has built a reputation for refined, forward-thinking electronic music.
omri.name: OMRI.

oskar-med-k-073dc.bio: oskar med k (real name Oskar Sjåvåg) is a Norwegian DJ and producer from Oslo who’s rapidly risen in the global electronic scene with his blend of emotive, melodic house and club-ready grooves. He first gained major attention with his 2025 breakout single “Make Me Feel,” which topped Shazam’s House Global chart and charted internationally, helping him build a large streaming audience and headline live shows across Europe and North America.
oskar-med-k-073dc.name: oskar med k

partiboi69.bio: Partiboi69 is an Australian DJ and producer known for his high-energy performances, humorous persona, and unmistakable presence in the global club scene. Blending satire with serious DJ skills, he has built a cult following through viral content, standout sets, and releases on labels like Steel City Dance Discs. With a mix of charisma and technical ability, he’s become one of the most recognizable names in modern underground dance music.
partiboi69.name: Partiboi69

pawsa.bio: Pawsa is a DJ and producer known for his stripped-back, groove-heavy take on tech house. As a co-founder of the influential label Solid Grooves, he’s built a global following through infectious basslines, minimal percussion, and high-energy club sets. His tracks regularly dominate dance floors from Ibiza to Miami, making him a staple in the underground house scene.
pawsa.name: Pawsa

peggy-gou.bio: Peggy Gou is a South Korean DJ, producer, and fashion icon who has become one of the most recognizable figures in the global electronic music scene. Known for her eclectic blend of house, techno, and disco-influenced sounds, she has headlined major festivals like Coachella and Glastonbury while releasing music on acclaimed labels including Ninja Tune and her own imprint Gudu Records. Beyond her music, she's equally celebrated for her bold personal style and has crossed over into fashion and pop culture in a way few DJs have managed.
peggy-gou.name: Peggy Gou

prospa-b0119.bio: Prospa is a UK electronic duo known for blending classic rave energy with modern house and breakbeat production. Their sound pulls from ‘90s UK hardcore and trance influences while delivering polished, high-impact club records built for peak-time sets. With releases on labels like CircoLoco Records and performances at major festivals and underground venues, Prospa have become a staple in the new wave of UK dance music.
prospa-b0119.name: Prospa

purple-disco-machine.bio: Purple Disco Machine is a German DJ and producer known for his signature blend of nu-disco, funk, and house. With a retro-inspired yet modern sound, he’s gained global acclaim through hits like Hypnotized and Fireworks, delivering feel-good, groove-heavy sets that light up dancefloors worldwide.
purple-disco-machine.name: Purple Disco Machine

rampa.bio: Rampa is a Berlin-based DJ, producer, and co-founder of the Keinemusik collective, known for a genre-fluid sound that moves fluidly between house, techno, and Afro-house. Growing up in Freiburg in Germany's Black Forest before relocating to Berlin, he helped launch Keinemusik in 2009 alongside longtime friends &ME, Adam Port, and Reznik. Beyond Keinemusik, he has released music on a wide range of respected imprints including Innervisions, Diynamic, Afterlife, Cocoon, Kompakt, and Defected, cementing his reputation across the broader electronic music world.
rampa.name: Rampa

ren-g.bio:
Ren G first gained attention through self-released music that mixed rap, pop, and electronic influences with deeply personal lyrics. Projects like Miss 24/7 and Hello! showcase her ability to shift effortlessly between melodic hooks, spoken-word flows, and futuristic production, creating a sound that feels equally inspired by internet culture and UK club music. 

Her genre-fluid style has earned her a growing fanbase and collaborations across the alternative music scene. Whether performing alongside artists like horsegiirL or releasing emotionally raw singles, Ren G continues to push beyond traditional pop and rap boundaries.
ren-g.name: Ren G

rohaan.bio: Rohaan is a UK-born DJ and producer known for his genre-bending electronic sound that blends drum & bass, bass music, and experimental club styles. His high-energy sets feature fast breaks, heavy basslines, and unpredictable transitions that keep crowds on their toes. Rohaan has gained international recognition through releases on major bass labels and performances at leading festivals and clubs.
rohaan.name: Rohaan

rossi.bio: Rossi. is a UK-based DJ and producer known for his groove-driven minimal and tech house sound. Rising through the underground scene with releases on labels like Fuse and solid performances across major European clubs and festivals, his style blends rolling basslines with stripped-back percussion designed for late-night dance floors.
rossi.name: Rossi.

san-pacho.bio: San Pacho is a Croatian DJ and producer known for his infectious fusion of tech house, Latin rhythms, and club-ready grooves. Since 2019, he has released tracks on top labels like Confession, Dim Mak, and Hau5trap, earning international recognition with hits like La Pasion and Oye. His high-energy sets have made him a standout on festival stages and club lineups worldwide.
san-pacho.name: San Pacho

sasha.bio: Sasha first rose to prominence in the early 1990s through his residency at Shelley’s Laserdome before becoming one half of the legendary duo Sasha & John Digweed. Together, they revolutionized DJ culture with iconic mix compilations like Renaissance: The Mix Collection and Northern Exposure, while their marathon residencies at New York’s Twilo became legendary for their storytelling and technical precision. Rather than treating DJing as a sequence of tracks, Sasha helped establish the idea of the DJ set as a carefully crafted musical journey.
sasha.name: Sasha

sasha-john-digweed.bio: When Sasha and John Digweed first teamed up at the legendary Renaissance nightclub in England in 1993, they pioneered a new style of DJing centered on storytelling rather than big drops. Their groundbreaking mix albums, Renaissance: The Mix Collection and Northern Exposure, became defining records of the progressive house movement and are still considered essential listening decades later. They later cemented their legendary status through marathon all-night residencies at New York’s iconic Twilo, where they redefined what a club experience could be.
sasha-john-digweed.name: Sasha & John Digweed

serafina.bio: Hamburg-based Serafina has carved out a distinctive space in the techno scene by combining raw industrial weight with the euphoric drive of hard bounce, building sets that thrive on contrast and connection. Since emerging in 2023 she has moved quickly, playing at Uebel & Gefährlich, Hï Ibiza, Amnesia Ibiza, and festivals including Rotterdam Rave and Verknipt, while sharing stages with the likes of Fumi and Zwilling. Still early in her ascent, she is one of the most exciting new voices in hard techno right now.
serafina.name: SERAFINA

seth-troxler-88557.bio: Seth Troxler is one of electronic music’s most instantly recognizable artists. He has carved out his own unique path as a cultural commentator, art curator, restaurateur and entrepreneur. Descended from a family of cowboys and Baptist preachers, Seth is part African-American, with a singular approach to viewing the world through the prism of contemporary music culture.
seth-troxler-88557.name: Seth Troxler

sextile.bio:
Formed by Brady Keehn and Melissa Scaduto, Sextile emerged from Los Angeles’ underground scene with a raw post-punk sound before evolving into one of electronic music’s most boundary-pushing acts. Over the years, they’ve traded guitars for drum machines, acid synths, breakbeats, and pounding techno rhythms, creating music that feels equally at home in a mosh pit or on a warehouse dance floor. Their recent albums, Push and yes, please., embrace everything from EBM and acid house to drum & bass and rave culture while never losing their punk spirit. 

Known for chaotic, high-energy performances, Sextile has become a favorite at festivals and clubs alike. Their shows blur the line between a live band and a DJ set, pairing distorted vocals, pounding electronics, and relentless BPMs with an anything-goes attitude that’s earned them a devoted cult following.
sextile.name: Sextile

silva-bumpa.bio: Silva Bumpa is a UK-based producer known for his high-energy, bass-driven tracks that blend UK garage, house, and rave influences. His music is playful and punchy, often featuring chopped vocals, bouncy rhythms, and nostalgic nods to classic UK club sounds while still feeling fresh and modern. With a growing presence in the underground scene, he’s become recognized for producing tracks that hit hard in both club and festival settings.
silva-bumpa.name: Silva Bumpa

skrillex.bio: Skrillex (Sonny Moore) is a Grammy-winning American producer and DJ who helped detonate dubstep into the US mainstream in the early 2010s before evolving into one of dance music's most versatile shapeshifters. His sound spans brostep, trap, house, and pop crossover, with landmark work from Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites to Jack Ü alongside Diplo, and his 2023 double-album run Quest for Fire and Don't Get Too Close. Live, he's known for relentless, genre-hopping sets packed with unreleased edits and chaotic energy that still hit as hard in a warehouse as on a festival main stage.
skrillex.name: Skrillex

snakehips.bio: Snakehips is a UK electronic duo known for their smooth blend of R&B-infused beats, hip-hop grooves, and laid-back dance production. Rising to global recognition with hits like All My Friends, they’ve become staples in the alt-pop and electronic scene, collaborating with major artists while maintaining a signature chill, groove-driven sound.
snakehips.name: Snakehips

sofi-tukker.bio: Sofi Tukker is a Grammy-nominated electronic music duo made up of Sophie Hawley-Weld and Tucker Halpern. Known for their vibrant, global-inspired dance sound, they blend house music with world music influences, energetic vocals, and colorful live performances that have made them festival favorites worldwide.
sofi-tukker.name: Sofi Tukker

sonny-fodera.bio: Sonny Fodera is an Australian DJ and producer who has become one of the most in demand names in the house music world, known for his smooth, melodic, and groove driven sound that sits perfectly at the intersection of underground credibility and mainstream appeal. Having relocated from Melbourne to the UK, he has built a massive following on both sides of the globe, releasing music on top labels and performing at major festivals and club nights worldwide. His consistent output and feel good energy have made him a staple of the modern house music scene.
sonny-fodera.name: Sonny Fodera

soraya.bio: Her genre-spanning sets move effortlessly between house, techno, and indie dance, creating an energetic yet carefully curated journey that’s earned her appearances at clubs, festivals, and underground parties across the West Coast. In 2025, she made her production debut with “Brain Delay” alongside Broken Hill on Adam Ten & Mita Gami’s Maccabi House label, receiving support from artists including Adam Ten, Mita Gami, Sam Shure, Enamour, and Audio Junkies. Alongside her growing catalog of original music, Soraya has shared the stage with artists such as Mita Gami, Chaim, Eli & Fur, Super Flu, and Session Victim, cementing herself as one of indie dance’s most exciting emerging talents.
soraya.name: SORAYA

steve-aoki.bio: Steve Aoki is a globally renowned DJ, producer, and entrepreneur known for his high-energy performances and genre-blending sound. Founder of Dim Mak Records, he’s collaborated with major artists across EDM, hip-hop, and pop, and is famous for his electrifying shows and crowd-hyping stage presence.
steve-aoki.name: Steve Aoki

subtronics.bio: Subtronics is one of the most influential figures in modern bass music, known for his boundary-pushing dubstep sound, explosive live performances, and unmistakable sound design. With a catalog of high-impact releases and a cult-like fanbase, Subtronics has become a defining force across festivals and bass-driven dance floors worldwide.
subtronics.name: Subtronics

supergloss.bio: Supergloss is a DJ and producer known for their eclectic mix of house, tech house, and melodic electronic sounds. Their sets combine groovy basslines, vibrant synths, and dancefloor-ready rhythms that keep crowds moving. Supergloss has been gaining recognition on the underground club circuit for energetic performances and dynamic, genre-blending productions.
supergloss.name: Supergloss

taiki-nulight.bio: Taiki Nulight is a UK-based DJ and producer known for his high-energy fusion of bass music and house. With roots in UK garage and bassline, his sound has evolved into a powerful blend of bass house, UKG, and breaks—delivering hard-hitting drops and infectious grooves. A staple in the global club and festival circuit, Taiki Nulight has earned support from major artists and labels while consistently pushing forward-thinking, genre-blurring productions. His sets are fast-paced, bass-driven, and designed to keep crowds moving at full intensity.
taiki-nulight.name: TAIKI NULIGHT

telykast.bio: TELYKAST is an American DJ and production duo known for their uplifting blend of melodic house and dance-pop. With emotional vocals, polished production, and feel-good energy, they’ve built a strong following through festival-ready tracks and radio-friendly releases.
telykast.name: TELYKAST

the-martinez-brothers.bio: The Martinez Brothers are a globally renowned DJ and producer duo from the Bronx, New York. Known for their infectious blend of house and tech house, they rose from the NYC underground to become international headliners, performing at major festivals and residencies while also running their influential label, Cuttin’ Headz.
the-martinez-brothers.name: The Martinez Brothers

tinlicker.bio:
Formed in Utrecht in 2012, Tinlicker has spent the last decade refining a sound that balances progressive house, melodic techno, and deep house with soaring vocals and cinematic storytelling. After early releases on labels like mau5trap and Zerothree, the duo found their home on Anjunadeep, where tracks like Because You Move Me, Need You, and Tell Me helped establish them as one of the label’s flagship artists. Their albums This Is Not Our Universe and In Another Lifetime cemented their reputation for creating emotional dance music that feels equally at home on a festival stage or during a late-night drive.

Known for flawless DJ sets and immersive live performances, Tinlicker has headlined venues and festivals including Red Rocks, Printworks, Tomorrowland, and Anjunadeep Open Air. Their music blends uplifting melodies, progressive grooves, and atmospheric sound design into sets that unfold patiently, making them favorites among fans of Lane 8, Ben Böhmer, and YOTTO.
tinlicker.name: Tinlicker

trikk.bio: Trikk is a Porto-born DJ and producer known for fusing UK club sensibilities with rich Brazilian and Afro-Latin percussion, creating a hypnotic, drum-driven strain of house and techno. He broke through internationally with releases on Dixon and Âme's Innervisions label, including standout EPs like "Florista," which became a staple in melodic house sets worldwide. Equally at home in intimate club rooms and festival stages, his sets balance deep grooves with organic, percussive energy that's made him a favorite across the global electronic circuit.
trikk.name: Trikk

tripolism.bio: Tripolism is a Copenhagen-based trio known for their distinctive blend of deep, melodic, and groove-driven house music. Their sound combines warm basslines, soulful vocals, and atmospheric textures, creating tracks that feel both intimate and dancefloor-ready. With a strong emphasis on mood and storytelling, Tripolism’s productions and DJ sets build emotional depth while maintaining a steady, hypnotic rhythm. As rising figures in the European electronic scene, they continue to gain recognition for their refined, genre-blurring approach and captivating performances.
tripolism.name: Tripolism

vintage-culture.bio: Vintage Culture — real name Lukas Rafael Ruiz Hespanhol — is a Brazilian DJ and producer who specializes in house music, blending influences from disco, techno, and pop to create a signature sound built on catchy melodies, groovy basslines, and nostalgic vibes. With over 1.5 billion streams, Diamond, Platinum, and Gold certifications, and a debut album (Promised Land) featuring collaborators like Solomun and CamelPhat, he has risen from a small-town dreamer to one of electronic music's biggest global names.
vintage-culture.name: Vintage Culture

william-kiss.bio: William Kiss is a Melbourne-born DJ and producer with a percussion-rooted sound built on rumbling basslines, groove-heavy undertones, and main-floor strength across house and techno. He's released on Peggy Gou's Gudu, Rekids, UNCAGE, and Carl Cox's 23rd Century, racking up over 5 million streams and earning support from Laurent Garnier, Carl Cox, Honey Dijon, and Pete Tong — with BBC Radio 1 tapping him as a 2025 "Future Dance Star." He also co-runs the Not Without Friends label and party collective with Luke Alessi and Jordan Brando, and teamed up with house legends Todd Terry and Roland Clark on his Gudu debut "House Machine."
william-kiss.name: William Kiss

winson.bio: Hailing from Dordrecht in the Netherlands, Winson’s journey into hard techno began in 2023 after receiving a set of turntables from a friend. What started as a passion project quickly gained traction on TikTok, where his unique approachof combining emotional vocal samples with pounding hard techno helped him stand out in a rapidly growing scene.
winson.name: Winson

worship.bio: WORSHIP is the drum & bass supergroup uniting four of the genre's biggest names: Sub Focus, Dimension, Culture Shock, and 1991. Together they deliver a relentless, arena-scale D&B experience, trading solo sets and back-to-backs built on festival-sized production and heavyweight basslines. It's four headliners on one stage — a full-throttle celebration of UK drum & bass at its peak.
worship.name: Worship

yellow-claw.bio: Yellow Claw is a Dutch DJ and production duo known for their explosive, high-energy sound that blends trap, bass, and electronic music into festival-ready anthems. Rising to global fame with massive hits and collaborations, they have built a reputation for pushing boundaries and creating genre-defying tracks that dominate both main stages and clubs worldwide. As founders of Barong Family, they have also played a key role in supporting emerging talent and shaping the global bass music scene. Their performances are intense, fast-paced, and packed with crowd-hyping drops, making them a staple at major festivals around the world.
yellow-claw.name: Yellow Claw

zedd.bio: Zedd began his musical journey as a classically trained pianist before transitioning into electronic music. His meticulous production style and melodic songwriting quickly earned him worldwide acclaim, leading to collaborations with artists including Foxes, Alessia Cara, Maren Morris, Selena Gomez, Ariana Grande, and Katy Perry. His breakout single “Clarity” won the Grammy for Best Dance Recording, while follow-up hits like “Stay,” “Stay the Night,” and “The Middle” cemented his status as one of dance music’s biggest stars. In 2024, he returned with his long-awaited third studio album, Telos, continuing to push the boundaries between electronic and pop music.
zedd.name: Zedd

zhu.bio: ZHU is a San Francisco-based DJ, producer, vocalist, and multi-instrumentalist who burst onto the scene in 2014 with his massive breakout single "Faded," earning a Grammy nomination for Best Dance Recording. Known for his sleek synth melodies, billowing basslines, and undeniable hooks, ZHU blends genres across a growing discography of albums and EPs that chart a carefully crafted journey from darkness to light. His live performances go far beyond a typical DJ set, incorporating live vocals, elaborate staging, and immersive theatrical concepts that have made him a standout fixture on the club and festival circuit.
zhu.name: Zhu

zulan.bio: ZULAN is an emerging electronic artist known for high-energy sets that blend melodic elements with driving house and techno rhythms. With a focus on groove and atmosphere, ZULAN delivers dynamic performances that resonate across both underground and festival stages.
zulan.name: ZULAN
